title: Rav Shayya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Zevachim 34b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.34b.17-18) he said, “It stands to reason as Rav Ashi says.” Hyman reports that in [Chullin 58b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.58b.7), Dikdukei Soferim reads “Rav Shayya said to him,” whereas the text he uses reads Rav Oshaya.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Chullin has Rav Oshaya replying to Mar bar Rav Ashi. The Shayya reading there is Hyman’s report from Dikdukei Soferim.
